package.name: scan_matching_localization
package.description: 2D LiDAR scan-to-map localization for the F1TENTH stack. Provides two registration-based localizers (ICP / kiss-icp-style and NDT) that match the same I/O contract as the particle_filter and cartographer localization modes: subscribe /scan + /vesc/odom + /map, publish a nav_msgs/Odometry pose in the map frame for robot_localization to fuse.
